content.jointProblem: How can Pannonia Osiguranje-Tech match farm policy locations, including addresses known only at settlement level, to field-level hail intensity estimates and test whether the resulting exposure indicators explain the observed 18% excess in hail claims? The first experiment would test spatial linkage and validation against the three available claim years, not assume that a pricing correction is already proven.

rationale.text: Lalić has measured expertise in spatial indexing for large polygon datasets, which can be transferred to indexing and joining policy locations against hail-grid polygons.

sources.quote: The hybrid block-clustered GiST reduced median bounding-box query time by 38 % relative to default GiST

rationale.text: He has tested spatial grid partitioning under high concurrency, which is relevant to partitioning weather grids and policy points for scalable matching.

sources.quote: Spatial grid partitioning achieved the highest throughput (1 340 tiles/s) and lowest 95th-percentile latency (310 ms) under peak load

rationale.text: He has built reference spatial pipelines covering coordinate precision normalisation and spatial grid partitioning on production-scale municipality datasets in the Serbia-Hungary border region.

sources.quote: The project developed a reference pipeline covering topological error correction, coordinate precision normalisation, spatial grid partitioning, and incremental tile cache management.

rationale.text: His group operates the PostGIS, GeoServer and Mapbox infrastructure needed to prototype and benchmark a policy-to-grid matching and visualisation pipeline.

sources.quote: dedicated GIS server cluster running PostGIS, GeoServer, and Mapbox GL JS

rationale.text: He has direct experience with CRS and OGC interoperability problems that can undermine a policy-to-grid join.

sources.quote: Common issues include absent GetFeatureInfo implementations, inconsistent EPSG code declarations, and missing INSPIRE metadata elements.

constraints.text: Policy geocoding is incomplete: many farm addresses are settlement-level only, so the plan must include an explicit geocoding or probabilistic linkage step, or additional parcel identifiers, before field-level matching is claimed.

sources.quote: a large share of our farm addresses are stored only at the settlement level, not as coordinates

constraints.text: The available weather grid is five-kilometre resolution, while the business problem is field-level hail intensity for narrow, fast-moving storms; any method must test whether this resolution is adequate or needs downscaling or auxiliary data.

sources.quote: daily gridded weather data from MeteoVoj d.o.o. at a five-kilometre resolution
Vojvodina hailstorms are narrow and fast-moving

constraints.text: Validation is limited to three claim years and about 1,200 farm policies, so the evaluation must be designed around that sample and must not overstate field-level accuracy outside it.

sources.quote: three full claim years with geo-tagged loss data for about 1,200 farm policies

constraints.text: The output must be automatable into the pricing model, not only a manual QGIS exercise; the company's small pricing and IT teams split operational support and new product build, so integration ownership and effort are hard requirements.

sources.quote: turning that into something that feeds the pricing model automatically is beyond what our team can do alone
applied development work is carried out by a four-person pricing team and a six-person IT team who split their time between operational support and new product build

constraints.text: The researcher's group has capacity for only one additional contract research engagement from mid-2026 onward, so the project timeline must respect that availability constraint.

sources.quote: capacity to take on one additional contract research engagement from mid-2026 onward

constraints.text: Data sharing must be arranged under NDA with anonymised but authentic policy, claim and weather records; otherwise the researcher's preferred collaboration mode is not met.

sources.quote: prefers industry partners who can share anonymised but authentic data under NDA

risks: The researcher's cited evidence is cadastral polygon indexing and web-map delivery, not hail intensity or insurance loss modelling; the transfer to hail exposure is unproven and must be tested in the first experiment.
The five-kilometre weather grid may not resolve narrow hail swaths that leave one village damaged and a farm two kilometres away untouched, so apparent field-level matches could be false.
Settlement-level addresses may make field-level exposure assignment uncertain and could bias which parts of the portfolio appear underpriced.

The company's small pricing and IT teams split operational support and new product build, and a prior flood-risk mapping prototype with a Novi Sad faculty was completed but not integrated into pricing, indicating an integration and maintenance risk.
The researcher's availability is not explicitly confirmed beyond the note of capacity from mid-2026, and the participation record marks availability as unknown.
NDA and anonymisation requirements may constrain what can be shared, published or reused, especially if the researcher wants authentic production data rather than synthetic benchmarks.
questions: Can Pannonia provide parcel identifiers or coordinates for the 1,200 farm policies, or is settlement-level address the only location data available?
What exactly does the MeteoVoj hail product contain: which hail variable, historical archive length, update frequency, uncertainty information and licensing terms for the three claim years?
What actuarial target defines success: a revised hail loading, a portfolio segment flag for underpriced policies, or a validated exposure index, and who in pricing will sign it off?
Will the collaboration be run as a joint project, and is there any interest in the researcher's open industrial PhD supervision option?
Can the company share anonymised policy, claim and weather data under NDA, and what publication or reuse rights would the researcher and any PhD student retain?
Who from the pricing and IT teams will own integration and maintenance after the project, and what compute environment will host the matching pipeline?
